mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in GDPC1 (demand) signals robust economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in expanding periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 4.5% (lower unemployment) signals a strengthening labor market, enhancing equity valuations and driving positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when UNRATE crosses below 4.5%, or p-value >0.05 in t-test comparing to baseline.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS falls below 1% AND UNRATE declines below 4.5%, accommodative monetary policy and tight labor markets jointly boost investor confidence, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to rise significantly (p >0.05) when both proxies meet their thresholds simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS (e.g., below 1%) signals monetary easing, which amplifies equity valuations and drives positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, 20-day returns do not rise when FEDFUNDS declines below 1% (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Continued monthly growth in INDPRO (supply) indicates expanding production capacity, reducing inflationary pressures and fostering growth, which drives positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to follow INDPRO's upward trend (p >0.05) or remain statistically insignificant.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in HOUST (demand) above 600 units signals robust consumer demand, spurring corporate investment and positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative when HOUST crosses above 600 (p >0.05) or remain insignificant.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in PAYEMS (labor) and GDPC1 (demand) indicate strong job growth and consumer spending, creating a virtuous cycle that drives positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to rise when both proxies increase (p >0.05) or remain statistically insignificant.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock recovery regime, a sharp increase in INDPRO above 92.5 (current value) signals production rebound, easing supply constraints and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns do not rise when INDPRO exceeds 92.5 in supply shock recovery regime (p >0.05) or remain insignificant.
